entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Steve. How can I help you today?
Hi Steve, I'd like to return a VeloBand Pulse I bought last month.
I can certainly help with that. Can I get your order number, please?

Thank you. Let me pull that up... Okay, I see the order. It looks like it was delivered about 36 days ago. Let's see the policy here... yep, you're well within the 90 days. So, no problem at all, we can get that returned for you.
Oh, fantastic! I wasn't sure what the window was. So I can get a full refund?
Absolutely. I've just initiated that for you. I'm sending a pre-paid return label to the email address on file. Just print it out, attach it to the box, and drop it off.
That's great, thank you so much.
You're very welcome. And I also see here you're a VIP member with us. As a thank you for your loyalty, I've gone ahead and added a $25 credit to your VeloFit account for your next purchase.
Wow, I was not expecting that. That's very generous. Thank you, Steve.
It's my pleasure. Once we receive the item back at our warehouse, your refund will be processed. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Nope, that's everything. You made that incredibly easy.
Glad to hear it! Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
